balls.text: off-pace and dug into the track just outside off. Powell swings like a rusty gate and swats away flies. Green pinches a bye, and KKR finish with 181!
oh! On a back of a length wide outside off. Powell tries to smash it into next week and misses it completely
low full toss on middle and leg. Green tugs it towards deep mid wicket
more streaky runs, but KKR will not care an iota! Slot ball just outside off. Green loses his shape and swings his blade like an axe. Gets a thick inside edge and the ball hurtles past short fine!
into the blockhole outside off. Powell cannot get under it and clinks it to the fielder stationed right behind the umpire

banged in short outside off and this skips well over the bowler's head. Powell swipes at it and misses. Wide called this time. And LSG review now. Surely this cannot be a legal delivery?! Top of Powell's head is measured at 1.83m. Ball passes at 1.9m, and the wide call stays!
smart, smart batting! Low full toss just outside off. Powell moves across his stumps and paddles it fine past the keeper!
top yorker again, tailing into the pads. Powell tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket
brilliant yorker on middle and off. Green squeezes it out to backward point. Powell says yes to the single and scampers across
brilliant yorker, zoning into leg stump. Powell stabs it off the inside edge into his pads, and the ball dribbles away into the off side for a single
right up in the blockhole on the stumps. Green drills it back past the bowler but he has to settle for a single as long off reins it in

another short ball outside off and this seems to sail above the batter's head again. Green jumps up, throws his hands at it and misses. Green reviews again, arguing it should be a wide. This seemed to be above his head. 2.03m is the magic mark, and the ball is above it. 2.12m according to Ball Tracking, and the wide has now been called!
Green lays into this, and it goes a mile! Slower ball on a length outside off. Green spots the variation early and slams it over long on!
zipped in very full on leg. Powell plays all around it and the ball pings off his pad into the off side
Green muscles his way to another boundary! Not his best but he will take it any which way they come. Full outside off. Green gives it all he has and shanks it to long on's right!

banged in short outside off. Green leaps into the air and swishes at it, only to connect with the fresh Kolkata air. Not called a wide but Green wants to review. This could be touch-and-go. The top of Green's head is measured at 2.03m. Ball passing through at 2.01m. But the third umpire now wants to check the direction too. Inside the tramlines, so KKR lose a review!
another low full toss outside off. Powell cannot get under this and shanks it to long on
full and a mile outside off. Left alone by Powell and called a wide
Powell continues to motor along! Another missed yorker outside off. Gentle full toss and Powell smears it to long on's right!
banged in short on middle and off. Powell a little rushed on the pull and he cloths it towards deep square leg. Mistimes it so badly that he can come back for two
on a length outside off. Green tries to smash it into next week and chunks it off the inside edge into the on side
fetch that too, says Rovman! Juicy full toss on the stumps. Powell opens up his stance and mauls it over deep mid wicket!
watch out, bowler and umpire! Prince misses the yorker outside off on the shorter side. Powell winds up and bludgeons it over the bowler's head!
low full toss on middle and leg. Green tugs it off the inside edge into his pad and has to settle for a single yet again
Green gets one away, finally! Slower bumper on off. Takes an eternity to arrive and when it does, Green arches his back to glide it between short third and backward point!
low full toss zoning into off. Powell cannot get under it and digs it out towards long off
excellent yorker, honing into middle and off. Green jams down on it and squeezes it out into the off side
pulls the length back on leg after seeing the batter advance. Green punches it to long off and keeps strike
darted in fuller on middle and leg. Powell tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket

into the stumps at the other end, but Green is safe! Full on the stumps. Powell drills it back to the bowler, who gets a hand to it and deflects it into the stumps at his end. Will technically go down as a chance because it came to the bowler on the full...
streaky but Powell will take it! Back of a length on leg. Skids through and Powell, swiping across the line, gets a faint inside edge that dribbles past the keeper!
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Powell cannot do much with it and clinks it back to the bowler
Powell has had enough of the pushing and prodding! Given a bit of air on a length on leg. Powell dances down and launches it over long on!
leg-cutter on a length outside off. Powell plays it late and opens his bat face to guide it past the slip. Retains strike
carrom ball on a back of a length on the pads. Green knocks it to long on
carrom ball on a back of a length on middle and leg. Green goes right back and plays the textbook back-foot defence...
back of a length on middle and off. Green continues to read Rathi off the pitch but can do nothing more than defend
back of a length on leg. Straightens a little and Green gets squared up. Prods it back to the bowler eventually
dragged down on middle and leg. Powell rocks back and heaves it towards deep square leg
fuller and wider outside off. Powell reaches out for it and shanks it down the ground to long on. Just a run off the 14th, and that was superb from Avesh!
almost a chop-on! Back of a length outside off. Powell tries to force the issue through the off side and nearly drags it onto his stumps
another bumper and this skips through sharply on leg. Powell is late on the short-arm-pull and the ball whistles past his blade

banged into the track outside off. Powell gets into an awkward position and his bat ends up acting like a periscope. Clinked back to the bowler, who then fires a throw into Powell. Avesh runs up to offer a hand of apology immediately after

knocks him over with a ripper, and Rinku is outta here! Back of a length, angling into off. On pitching, though, it decks away just a shade. Rinku tries to poke at it but is beaten by the movement against the angle. Off stump pegged back, and KKR losing their way here!
hard length just outside off. Rinku stays back and taps it towards extra cover
low full toss outside off. Rinku throws his hands at it and drills it towards sweeper cover
off-pace again, on a length just outside off. Rinku comes forward and pushes it towards extra cover
slower ball on a back of a length just outside off. Green taps it into the pitch and the ball bounces up over Shami, allowing a single
back of a length outside off. Rinku uses the pace and runs it down to deep third
low full toss just outside off. Green gets his bat down in time and pushes it to long off
back of a length on middle and off. Rinku steps down and swishes at it, only to squirt it off the inside edge towards the keeper
back of a length on middle and leg. Green hangs back before playing it towards the bowler
length ball on the pads. Rinku stabs it to deep mid wicket and gets off the mark

holes out to long on, and LSG's spinners are applying the squeeze! Speared in full on leg. Raghuvanshi skips down but gets too close to the ball. Cannot get under it enough and arrows it straight down Markram's throat. KKR lose two in quick succession, and LSG now have a more than decent foothold in this contest!
darted in on a length on the pads. Green tucks it towards deep backward square leg
angled in fuller on leg. Raghuvanshi gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg
on a length just outside off. Straightens a touch and Green pushes it to sweeper cover
fired in full on leg. Green eases it to long on and keeps strike
leg-cutter, on a length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi opens his bat face slightly and punches it towards deep point
googly on a fuller length outside off. Green plants his front foot and drills it to long off to open his account
incoming ball, on a back of a length on middle. Green reads it off the pitch and prods it into the on side

has that carried?! Looks like it has, and Shami throws away the ball to the umpire rather nonchalantly! Rahane asked to wait, though! Dragged down outside off. Rahane winds up and hacks it flat towards mid wicket, where Shami lunges low to his right and seems to gobble it up cleanly. The third umpire has been called into question this time, and it seems like his fingers are underneath the ball. Third umpire taking multiple looks, and he concludes it is a clean catch. Right call made, and Rahane has to go!
length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi pats it enough to extra cover's left for a single
dug in short on middle and off, and this gets a little big on the batter. Tugged towards deep square leg
another loose ball and put away! Full toss drifting into the pads. All Raghuvanshi has to do is get decent contact on it and he does so with aplomb, finding the fine leg fence!
slower ball on a length just outside off. Rahane pokes it into the mid on region and picks up another single
back of a length on middle and leg. Raghuvanshi gets inside the line and glances it down to long leg
into the blockhole on middle and off. Raghuvanshi jams down on it and digs it out towards the bowler
banged in so short that Prince's toe-nails were in danger for a moment. Slides down leg harmlessly and called a wide
shortish on middle and leg. Rahane uses the angle and helps it down to fine leg
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi hangs back and jabs it towards backward point
full outside off. Raghuvanshi plants his front foot and powers it straight to extra cover
into the stands, almost! Fullish and sliding down leg. Seems like a change-up and Raghuvanshi waits for it before whipping it over long leg!
leg-cutter on a back of a length on off. Raghuvanshi stabs it into the spaces between long on and deep mid wicket, and hares back for a brace
fuller but similarly wide outside off. Rahane drills it out towards deep point

bat goes one way, ball goes the other! But it does not matter where the bat has gone because the ball has landed beyond the ropes! Back of a length outside off. Rahane throws his bat at it, quite literally, and the ball flies over backward point!
slanted in on a length on off. Stops in the surface and Rahane plonks it uppishly past the bowler
dragged down outside off. Raghuvanshi waits for it before jabbing it towards sweeper cover
fullish on middle and leg. Rahane dinks it into the mid wicket region and picks up a single
what timing! Full on middle and leg. Rahane presses forward and clips it beautifully between long on and deep mid wicket. The ball hits the practice pitches and screams to the fence!

big lbw shout, but the impact may have been outside off! Slower on a full length outside off. Raghuvanshi misses his reverse and the bowler is very interested. Rathi tries to convince Pant but the skipper was having none of it
carrom ball on a full length outside off. Rahane comes forward and knocks it to long off
fullish on middle and off. Raghuvanshi comes forward and punches it straight to extra cover
back of a length on the pads. Rahane glances it to short fine leg and keeps things ticking
back of a length on off. Raghuvanshi hangs back and dabs it towards backward point, who slides to his left and ensures it is just a single
the runs continue to flow! Pushed in fuller on middle and off. Raghuvanshi gets down on one knee early and nails the sweep behind square. One bounce and into the fence!
slanted in on a length on off. Raghuvanshi comes forward and drives it on the up past extra cover. Back for a brace
angled in full on the pads. Rahane eases it out to deep mid wicket
through the gap now - this is excellent batting! Back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi gets on top of the bounce and threads it between extra cover and cover point!
Raghuvanshi goes all the way now! Slot ball outside off and lots of width to work with. Raghuvanshi throws his hands at it and carves it over cover!
nicely done! Banged in short and there is just enough width on offer. Raghuvanshi hops up onto his toes and scythes it over short third!
low full toss outside off. Rahane laces his cover drive but Choudhary at extra cover sprawls to his right to save three. Rahane will feel he missed out there
into the blockhole outside off. Raghuvanshi tries to counter it by trying the sweep but misses it completely, with the ball pinging off his boot into the on side
back of a length outside off and this skips through. Raghuvanshi shapes for the cut but is beaten for pace
darted in full on middle and off. Rahane flicks it to long on's right and has enough time to canter back for two
more runs for Rahane! Angled in full, on middle and leg. Rahane moves to the leg side early and slices it over short third!
up and over! Not off the middle but Rahane gets enough on this. Gives himself room to this full ball on middle and lifts it over mid off!
oh, almost a wicket! Back of a length outside off. Rahane has a wild mow at it and chunks it off the inside edge into the flap of his back pad
much fuller outside off. Rahane stretches forward before turning it towards square leg
dragged down outside off but Rahane cannot cash in. Scuffed into the off side
pushed in again, on a length on middle and leg. Raghuvanshi has a hoick at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine. That was bowled at 111.4kph!
back of a length just outside off. Raghuvanshi stands up tall and punches it towards cover point
darted in again, on a back of a length on off. Rahane bunts it to mid on and saunters across to the other end
magnificent from the skipper! Back of a length on middle and leg. Rahane backs away early, gets his hands through the ball and caresses it over extra cover!
back of a length on middle and off. Rahane lets the ball come to him before stabbing it to square leg
sprayed down leg. Raghuvanshi misses his flick and Pant fumbles too, allowing a couple of extras
fired in on a back of a length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi stays back and jabs it into the off side
slower ball on a full length outside off. Raghuvanshi drills it to mid on, where Rathi sprawls to his left and saves a certain boundary
back of a length, zoning into leg stump. Raghuvanshi stays further leg side before tapping it into the off side
take that, says the youngster! Back of a length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi gives himself room and flays it over cover!
back of a length outside off. Skids through and Raghuvanshi chalks it off the toe-end towards slip
length outside off. Raghuvanshi gets a half stride in and punches it on the up towards cover point
full and wide outside off. Raghuvanshi reaches out for it and scuffs it towards extra cover
back of a length outside off. Rahane hangs back and pushes it towards cover point
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi gets up on his toes and dabs it down to deep backward point

goes a mile up, and taken on the fence! Hard length just outside off and this seems to rear up slightly. A bit of away movement too and Allen, mowing across the line, gets a massive top edge. Rathi settles himself on the deep third fence and takes it smartly to his left, while standing right on the fence. Top grab, and LSG's powerplay incision continues. But hang on, replays suggest that Rathi was perilously close to touching the skirting. There was not an extensive check. Maybe there should have been one. A slight suggestion that one of the cushion may just have moved. Well well...
full on middle and off, and shaping away. Allen jams down on it and slices it towards extra cover
four more! Banged in short just outside off. Allen sits deep in his crease and hacks it past short fine leg!
Allen with his first boundary too! Shortish again and angling into the hips. Allen uses the angle and tugs it behind square!
spears it down leg first up but the ball swings back towards Pant after passing the batter. He does well to get a glove to it
Rahane with a rasping riposte! Shami goes searching and over-pitches outside off. Rahane plants his front foot and thunders it back past the bowler!
back of a length outside off. Allen goes fishing at it away from his body and edges it down to deep third
wow! Allen all at sea here. On a back of a length just outside off and this decks in. Allen advances, hacks at it and gets cut in half
this is superb bowling! On a length just outside off. Shapes away a touch in the air and then snakes away off the pitch. Allen misses it by a mile
oh! Back of a length outside off and this seams away sharply. Allen goes wafting at it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
fullish and shaping away outside off. Rahane opens his bat face and runs it down to deep backward point

a missed swish, and a missed throw too! And the Super Giants have scraped through! Oh, what drama. Avesh does not have his helmet on but he does have his skates on, and good for LSG that he did! Mukul falls down to the turf. He thanks the heavens. And he then gets mobbed by his LSG teammates. What a moment for the youngster. This was a short ball outside off. Mukul, for a change, swung and missed, but Avesh, famously part of another such thriller while batting once upon a time in Bengaluru, scrambles across with every sinew. Raghuvanshi took a split second extra to line up his throw but missed his mark. KKR do not know what has hit them. KKR do not know where to look. But they only need to look at that youngster wearing number 15 in red and blue, and that is who denied KKR. And based on today's evidence, they might not be the only side he denies in the IPL!

oh my good lord - what is this boy made of?! Hang that in the Louvre! Wow. Just wow. There are no more superlatives left. Missed yorker. Just by a touch, though. Outside off and Mukul's bat is there to meet it. Swishes at it with all he has and he creams it over deep cover. One of the all-time great shots in the IPL!

well well! Arora winning this battle now! This is another sizzling yorker. A mile outside off. Mukul walks across his stumps, trying to scoop it. All he manages is a nutmeg, though, and that is another dot!
brilliant yorker outside off, and the crowd finds its voice. Right under the bat. Mukul wanted to go downtown but not much he could do with that. Exemplary execution under immense pressure!

bam! Mukul is having a ball out there at the Eden G, and KKR do not know what has hit them! Back of a length on middle and off. Mukul gets his front foot out of the way and smears it over deep backward square leg!
back of a length on middle and off. Avesh tucks it into the deep mid wicket region and brings Mukul back on strike
pick the bones out of this one! A crack off the bat, and LSG still believe! Half-way down outside off. Mukul picks it in a flash and crrrrrrrrrunnnnnnnchhhhessssss it over deep mid wicket!

off the top edge but guess what, they all count! Green tests out the middle of the track again. Gets a little big on the batter, who while swinging at it agriculturally, gets a top edge that loops over the keeper!
nicked but well short! Off-pace on a length wide outside off. Mukul tries to fetch it but only seems to get a nick on it. On the bounce to the keeper
flat six, and Mukul keeps LSG breathing! Another slower short ball but Mukul has read this very early. He winds up and pummels it over the long leg fence!
slower bumper just outside off. Mukul has a wild swipe across the line and gets pinged near the right shoulder blade

oh, this has gone way up, and it lands into safety! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Mukul has a swish at it and mistimes it horribly. So much of a miscue that the ball lands right on the edge in the mid off region
back of a length delivery hung up wide outside off. Avesh swings like a rusty gate, and his bat ends up in a different postcode to the ball
shortish outside off. Mukul opens up his stance and heaves it to deep mid wicket. Takes the single this time, since it is the fifth ball of the over
this is a mighty hit! Into orbit! Juicy full toss outside off. Mukul goes deep into his crease and wallops it a mile over long on!
dug in short outside off. Mukul sits deep in his crease and hacks it to deep mid wicket
full toss outside off. Mukul powers it down the ground to long on, and opts not to take the single
oh goodness gracious me - what is this hitting?! This is pure strength. Raw power. Short and wide. Mukul reaches out for it, snaps his wrists into action and boshes it over long off!
banged in short outside off. Avesh swings himself off his feet but gets nowhere close to the ball
juicy full toss outside off. Mukul sits deep in his crease and hoicks it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
oh, hello! Where has this come from?! Attempted yorker and following the batter outside leg. Mukul channels his inner MS Dhoni and helicopters it over long on!

finds the gap, eventually! Slower bumper outside off. Mukul fetches it and swipes it towards deep square leg. Ramandeep, moving to his left, gets his left hand to it but the ball inadvertently rolls into the fence!
zipped in very full on leg. Mukul looks to dig it out but is too late on the flick. Jammed on the boot
half-tracker outside off. Mukul gets up on his toes and swats it towards deep backward square leg. Single denied

Shami slogs and Shami falls! Narine doing his thing again. Slows it up on a length on off. Shami has had enough of the defensive play and swings at it with all his might. Drags it a little, though, and deep square leg does not have to move a muscle. Narine celebrates, and that is a sight you do not see very often. LSG on the brink!
peach! Shami has no clue about it. Not the first, not the last either. On a length outside off. Jags away and breezes past the outside edge of Shami's bat
this is the one that comes in. On a length just outside off and Mukul sweeps it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off. Mukul, caught on the crease, wafts at it and is beaten again
back of a length outside off and this seams away. Mukul has no clue about it and gets beaten all ends up as he nibbles at it
full just outside off. Nips away and Mukul, jabbing at it, squirts it off the outside edge towards short third
fired in on a length on off. Mukul hangs back and stabs it to long on to retain strike
back of a length on middle and off. Spins away and Shami, sitting deep in his crease, nudges it into the square leg region

chipped straight to long off, and is that the game?! This is brave and beautiful bowling. Hung up wider and given just enough air to tempt Badoni into the inside-out lofted drive. He has to reach out in front too much, though, and all he manages is a chip into Rinku's palms. Anukul with another major breakthrough, and LSG's chase is flagging!
full toss and dumped beyond the ropes! This is a proper buffet ball. Badoni rubs his eyes in disbelief and then clubs it over long on. Brings up a superb half-century under pressure!
full and wide outside off. Badoni backs away and drills it straight to extra cover
back of a length on middle and off. Badoni hangs back and chunks it off the inside edge into his pads
slower ball into the track just outside off. Badoni waits for it and tugs it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
stunning batting! Not a great ball, in truth. But the shot is still worth drooling over. Short, wide and Badoni carves it over backward point!
short and wide outside off. Badoni jumps up onto his toes and cuts it past backward point, who is a little guilty of diving over it. Back for a brace
back of a length outside off. Badoni has a waft at it and under-edges it towards the keeper
this is even better! Slower ball that lands right in the slot outside off. Badoni gets his hands through the ball and scorches it past extra cover!
welcomed back with a boundary! Slot ball outside off. Badoni throws his hands at it and lofts it easily over extra cover!
floated up full outside off. Mukul comes forward and drives it straight to extra cover

through him, and Samad has to walk too! Slowed up on a fullish length on middle and off. Samad  is enticed into a slog and loses his shape a tad. Misses the ball completely as it slides in with the angle. The ball kisses the back leg and then thuds into the stumps. LSG in all sorts of trouble now!
short and wide again. Samad shoulders arms and the umpire signals for a wide again
safe! Full toss on the stumps. Badoni looks to go big but scuffs it. On the bounce to Green at long on
back of a length delivery wider outside off. Called a wide this time
top shot! Darted in full and down leg. Badoni brings out the sweep and razes it between short fine leg and deep square leg!
length ball hidden wide outside off. Just inside the tramlines, though, meaning Badoni does not get the wide after letting it go
fired in full on middle and off. Samad comes forward and knocks it to long on
on a length outside off. Samad gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards sweeper cover
back of a length outside off and this whizzes through. Samad looks to drive on the up and sees the ball whistle past his flailing blade. That was bowled at 146kph!

yet another LSG batter falls to the short ball! Bashed into the track just outside off. Pooran looks to swipe it out of sight but makes a mess of it. Shanks it terribly and Ramandeep, stood well inside the long on fence, accepts the offering with glee. LSG falling apart now!
back of a length on middle and off. Badoni gets up on his toes and turns it towards deep mid wicket
smartly done! Slow, short and wide. Badoni jumps up onto his toes and slashes it over short third. Too easy for Badoni, with that field!
starts off with a short and wide delivery. Badoni swishes at it and misses. Called a wide
another change-up, on a back of a length outside off. Pooran jabs it towards sweeper cover and canters back for a brace
takes the pace off again, on a shortish length just outside off. Pooran has an ungainly mow at it and is too early into the stroke
another cutter, on a back of a length outside off. Pooran waits for it before dabbing it towards backward point
another slower ball, hung up full and wide. Pooran reaches out for it and drills it towards long off, where Rahane tumbles to his right and saves two
slower bumper outside leg and this balloons over the batter's head. Called a wide. Could have been a wide on both direction and height
off-pace and dug into the track outside off. Pooran has a wild swipe across the line and misses the ball by a mile
slower ball on a full length outside off. Pooran comes forward and drives it straight to extra cover
fired in full on middle and off. Badoni comes forward and blocks
Back of a length outside off. Badoni gets squared up and prods it behind point
Length ball on the pads. Pooran lets the ball come to him before tucking it towards deep mid wicket
Another play and miss! This is fuller in and around off. Goes the other way now and beats Pooran on the outside as he prods at it
Back of a length outside off. Pooran stays back and pats it into the off side
how has that missed?! Back of a length on middle and off. Snakes back in sharply and Pooran is cut in half. Perilously close to the top of middle stump too!
caught but it will not count! Banged into the track again, on middle and leg. Pooran mistimes his pull and Powell runs in off the deep mid wicket fence to catch it. Pooran gets a run for his troubles
oh dear! Another slower bumper outside off and this loops over the batter's head too. Pooran lets it go and the No ball has been called because it is the second bouncer over the head!
Pooran is up and running! Slower ball outside off and this sits up nicely. Pooran gets his front hip out of the way and wallops it over deep mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Badoni lifts up his front leg and short-arm-jabs it on the bounce to mid on
slower ball on a back of a length on middle and leg. Pooran drops it into the off side and opens his account
starts off with a bumper outside off. Sails a mile over Pooran and he would have needed a step-ladder to get to that. Don't think there will be any reviews on this wide!

Pant miscues a pull, and KKR's million-dollar buy delivers with the ball straightaway! Short and finishing just outside off. Pant has a swipe at it but has to fetch it from around his back shoulder. Skews it tamely off the top edge and Tyagi, moving to his right from short fine leg, makes no mistake. Green is thrilled to bits, and LSG in a spot of bother now!
short outside off. Badoni rises with the bounce and cuts it towards deep point
on a length on middle and off, and this spins away. Pant gets squared up and plonks it off the leading edge towards short third
back of a length on middle and leg. Badoni reads it off the pitch and helps it behind square
length ball on the pads. Pant tucks it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Badoni works it to deep mid wicket
fullish outside off. Badoni looks to go inside-out but shanks it back to the bowler instead
short outside off. Pant hops back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
slower bumper on middle and off. Pant walks across, trying to help it over short fine but toe-ends it into the deep square leg region instead
that is splendid! Slot ball just outside off. Pant skips down the track and thunders it to long off's right. That was hit very hard!
length ball hung up wide outside off. Badoni scuffs it towards sweeper cover
length ball on the pads. Pant presses forward and tucks it to deep square leg
shortish just outside off. Badoni rises with the bounce and drops it into the off side for a sharp single
that has flown to the fence! Marginally short outside off. Badoni stands up on his toes and knifes it past backward point!
back of a length on off. Badoni goes back and tucks it towards mid wicket
slower and fuller on off. Badoni lunges forward and plays down the wrong line. Pinged on the front pad but that spun too much
shot! Shorter, wider and Badoni takes full toll. He gets on top of the bounce and caresses it through point!
back of a length on middle and leg. Pant dinks it into the square leg region. Pant contemplates the second briefly before deciding against it
back of a length just outside off. Badoni reads it off the pitch and knocks it to long on
back of a length just outside off. Badoni sits deep in his crease and defends
short again, on middle and leg. Badoni gets inside the line and hooks it to fine leg
short ball nearly does the trick again! In the end, Badoni gets six for his toil. Dug in short outside off. Badoni top-edges his pull and musters enough sauce to clear fine leg!
banged half-way down again and this tails a touch down leg. Badoni happy to duck under it

gloved through the keeper, and Arora is turning on the heat! Not the best ball he will ever bowl, but this gets the job done. Short and sliding down leg. Marsh only needs to help it fine but the tickle is so faint that the keeper can come around to gather. Marsh throws his head back in disappointment, and KKR have gone back-to-back!
back of a length on middle and leg. Pant gets on top of the bounce and turns it into the square leg region

miscued a mile up, and Powell does the rest! Arora lands KKR's first punch! Dug in short just outside off. Markram looks for that favoured pull of his but the ball gets a tad big on him. Cannot quite control his stroke and the ball spoons up to deep mid wicket. Arora is pumped. The crowd is pumped too, and this is a big wicket!
Marsh goes big now! Angled in on a length on middle and leg. Marsh gets down on one knee and whacks it over deep square leg!
tossed up again, full on middle and leg. Markram stretches forward and knocks it to long off
flighted up full just outside off. Markram looks to hit it too hard and drags it towards square leg
loopy yorker outside off. Marsh jams down on it and digs it out towards long off
back of a length on middle and off, and this skids through low. Markram stabs it off the back foot towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on off. Marsh hangs back and punches it to long off
another slower ball, on a length on the pads. Markram tucks it off his hips towards deep square leg
off-pace and into the track outside off. Marsh hops up onto his toes and taps it into the point region
slower ball on a length on middle. Nips back in and raps Markram on the pad as he misses his flick. Might have been sneaking down
this is a Markram special! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Markram reads the slower ball like the morning daily and cracks it between mid off and extra cover!
this is a shot and a half! Back of a length on middle and leg. A repeat of the last stroke but this has much more on it. Hoisted over deep mid wicket!
just over! Back of a length on middle and leg. Markram lifts up his back leg, brings his wrists into play and whips it over mid wicket!
floated up full on off. Markram winds up and drills it towards long off
drifts down leg with a very full ball. Markram does not get bat on it and the umpire has to indulge in some more exercise
speared in on a length on the pads. Marsh misses his sweep and the ball bobbles off the pad towards short fine leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Markram waits on it before flicking it towards deep mid wicket
on a length on leg. Not a lot of room to work with and Marsh pushes it towards long off
back of a length on middle and off. Holds a touch in the surface and Marsh prods it back to the bowler
darted in on a length on leg but this continues further down with the angle. Good take by the keeper. Called a wide, though
tossed up full on middle and off. Markram lunges forward and pushes it to long off
back of a length, shaping into the pads. Markram punches it enough to mid on's right and keeps strike
back of a length outside off. Nips in, kicks up a little and the ball pops off the splice into the off side
back of a length on middle and leg. Markram rises with the bounce and defends into the on side
in-swinger, on a back of a length and finishing on off. Marsh tips it towards extra cover and hares across to the other end
back of a length just outside off. Marsh gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side
short, wide and punished! Marsh is sweating on that sort of delivery, especially early in his innings. He frees his arms and crashes it past backward point!
